tagline: Learn by watching. Prove it by shipping.
headline: Teach a machine to draw one straight line.
lede: One neuron holds two numbers. Training is the loop that turns them from random into right. Every network you will ever meet is this loop, with more neurons — so this is the one to understand properly.
_howToAddAVideo: Set lesson.video to {"provider":"youtube","id":"<11-char id>"}, {"provider":"vimeo","id":"<numeric id>"}, or {"provider":"mp4","url":"https://..."}. Leave provider as "pending" until the video is recorded — the site shows a placeholder instead of a broken player.

modules.title: ANN Regression
modules.summary: A neural network that predicts a number. One neuron, one straight line, and the training loop that every larger network is built from — model, loss, optimiser, repeat.
modules.project: Train the notebook on a feature that actually carries signal, print the loss as it falls, then swap in a hidden layer without changing the training loop.
outcomes: Name the four pieces every trained network needs, and what each one does
Build and train nn.Linear in PyTorch, end to end
Explain what zero_grad, backward and step each do in the loop
Shape data to (rows, features) and debug a shape error
Read a learned weight as a claim about the data — and spot a feature with no signal

lessons.title: ANN Regression — training one neuron in PyTorch

concepts.does: Holds the two numbers that get adjusted
Scores how wrong a prediction is
Decides how to adjust them, and by how much
Repeats until the loss stops falling
